scope: Routing/UI/cache qualification with existing source-approved sentence units. New219-word/target transfer packs remain separately unpromoted.

ownership.android: android_delivery: core LookupFirst request/policy/tests, ConversationImmersion cache/action, ImmersionBubble state, native capture
ownership.apple: apple_delivery: Swift corresponding routing/cache/UI/tests and native capture
ownership.immersion: immersion_engine: exact fixtures, source-unit catalog/semantic proof, evaluation contract
ownership.promotion: root: cross-platform acceptance and release decision

request_intents.automaticImmersion: Visible message preparation. Existing exact complete reference remains first. A confirmed-source, nonempty anchored approved partial satisfies this request without checking model readiness, full translation, or alignment.
request_intents.fullTranslation: Explicit user request for whole target language. Reuse valid complete cache/reference, otherwise request at most one bounded local full translation. Preserve approved source faces throughout.

sufficiency: Normal input validation and confirmed source direction remain required; do not infer language solely from one lexical hit.
At least one approved, changed, source-anchored selected span at requested density; native word/token budgets and mandatory target readings pass existing structural checks.
Producer is the exact verified accepted catalog in this experiment, with catalog SHA and reference IDs; target-dependent dictionary guesses cannot enter source-only producer.
No synthetic full target message assembled from mixed words. translation remains nil until a valid full reference exists.
cache: Automatic accepts same-identity valid partial or complete cache, including after model-ready changes and re-entry; no automatic second inference.
Explicit full accepts only a valid complete cache as complete. Keep partial cache while loading/error; failure does not erase useful slots.
Coalesce identical full requests by conversation/request generation, selected input language, exact source text, pair and accepted catalog version; do not share stale identities.
full_extension: Use installed local provider through existing literal translation/identifier validation; no remote translation API or silent model download.
30second provider timeout per extension, based on observed prepared-model first-call peaks above11seconds; cancellation/invalidation remains immediate for UI.
Preserve partial span identities, source ranges, readings and continuous-flip phase; attach completeTranslation without replacing source-authorized faces with newly guessed alignment.
When approved partial exists, avoid heavy target-dependent lexical/frame alignment whose result would otherwise be discarded. Misses retain existing full-context alignment path.
ui: Whole-target language action is visible for supported pairs even when translation is absent. Explicit action invokes fullTranslation; no proactive call just to display the menu.
While awaiting full reference, keep current approved immersion visible with a bounded loading indication; never label mixed text as complete target language.
On success show exact full target text; on error/model absence retain partial, show a concise recoverable state and explicit retry/download-management route.
Prevent duplicate taps from launching duplicate inference. Leaving/changing message/conversation/language or canceling cannot publish a stale result.
Existing copy-original/report/speech and continuous slots remain available. Speech follows the visible original/mixed/full state only.
qualification: Freeze unchanged native control source and record actual calls to modelsReady, translate, heavy align plus partial callbacks and first/warm timings.
Run exact six fixtures; valid old partial should change control1provider call→candidate0 automatic, explicit extension0→1 then repeat0 with prepared models.
Record actual unsupported/provider-unavailable platform status rather than injecting a translation and claiming native inference. Deterministic core error/cancel tests are labelled synthetic.
Actual UI: partial visible, target action invokes once, in-flight indication/error preserves slots and phase, source copy and original mode remain correct.
No promotion from tests alone; root reviews native receipts and existing source-unit semantic provenance.
